_說明: 根因追蹤「事件完整版」設定（雲端R 11-14，【新】總指揮 11-14 派工）。這裡只放：哪一個官方人事稿觸發、兩條起因怎麼分類（正規式）、官方原文要引哪幾句。官方原文每一句都由 tools/rc_dossier.py 實際打開官方頁逐字核對，核不到就不顯示；媒體出處全部由程式從證據池挑、打開核對。中文說明（zh）只翻譯核到的那一句，不加推論。

q_affair.quote: I was unfaithful to my wife.
q_affair.zh: 黃仁勳在官方新聞室公開的致員工信中承認對妻子不忠，並向家人、同事與股東道歉。

q_target.quote: in light of recent reporting that founder and CEO Jensen Huang has been the target of a foreign intelligence effort
q_target.zh: 董事會表示，因為媒體報導黃仁勳成為外國情報行動的「目標」，啟動獨立調查。

q_nocomp.quote: the Board has no reason to believe that either national security or NVIDIA secrets were compromised
q_nocomp.zh: 董事會表示沒有理由認為國家安全或輝達機密外洩，但調查會檢視所有資訊。

q_counsel.quote: retained former acting U.S. Attorney of the Southern District of New York Joon H. Kim and his firm Wachtell, Lipton, Rosen & Katz
q_counsel.zh: 獨立董事聘請前紐約南區代理聯邦檢察官 Joon H. Kim 與 Wachtell, Lipton, Rosen & Katz 律師事務所主持調查。

q_email_ns.quote: Regarding the national security concerns raised in news reports, NVIDIA’s Board of Directors has initiated an independent investigation
q_email_ns.zh: 黃仁勳信中說，針對媒體提出的國安疑慮，董事會已啟動獨立調查，他會全力配合。

q_resign.quote: Jensen Huang has resigned as President, Chief Executive Officer, and a member of the Board, effective immediately
q_resign.zh: 董事會宣布黃仁勳辭去總裁、執行長及董事職務，即刻生效。

q_interim.quote: Colette Kress, current Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer of NVIDIA, has agreed to serve as Interim Chief Executive Officer
q_interim.zh: 執行副總裁暨財務長 Colette Kress（克瑞斯）擔任臨時執行長，同時續任財務長。

q_search.quote: The Board is initiating a search for a permanent Chief Executive Officer and will consider internal and external candidates
q_search.zh: 董事會開始物色正式執行長，內部與外部人選都會考慮。

q_chair.quote: appointed Harvey C. Jones as its first-ever Chair of the Board
q_chair.zh: 董事會任命 Harvey C. Jones 為首位董事長（曾任 Synopsys 執行長暨執行董事長）。

q_orders.quote: we expect the company’s operations, customer commitments and product roadmap to continue without interruption
q_orders.zh: 董事長 Harvey Jones：預期公司營運、對客戶的承諾與產品路線圖不會中斷。

q_earn.quote: will report its third-quarter fiscal 2027 financial results on Tuesday, November 17
q_earn.zh: 第三季（2027 會計年度）財報照原訂 11/17（美國時間週二）公布。
